title: Psychemagik remix Xinobi
content:
We at The Fix are renowned trendsetters. We knew it was all about the bass before Meghan Trainor was even born. So it will come as no surprise to many of you that our featured Artist of the Week last month, Psychemagik, have released a stomping remix of Xinobi’s “Bogota”.

Xinobi’s debut album ‘1975’ is was released earlier this week (stay tuned for further new on the man), and this remix confirms what we’ve suspected for a long time: it’s going to be pretty good.

Conal Dougan
